sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/374 (ReserveOhio API: place 374, facilities 546-549, all units, 2027-06-15; sample sites on 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16, 2027-06-19; read 2026-10-31)

values.note: Every RV site has electric: $39 a night; full hookups $52. The same on a Saturday. Off-peak (November 2026 to March 2027) $35 on both. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-31.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all units, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 39.00, Full Hookup 52.00, Fee 6.50); sites 23395, 23439 on Sat 2027-06-19 and off-peak dates, read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/salt-fork-state-park-campground ('Sites include full hook-up, 50-amp electric') + ReserveOhio details (Electricity Hookup 50; Sewer and Water Hookup Yes), read 2026-10-31

values.note: 208 RV sites in loops A, C, E, F and G, pads 18-72 ft, all back-in: 168 electric, 40 full hookup. Nine pads under 23 ft. Excludes the 40-site equestrian camp, 22 primitive and 3 tent sites.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid and details (Pad Length, PullInTypeName Back In), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Heated shower houses. Registered campers have their own beach, boat launch and 60 docks.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/salt-fork-state-park-campground ('Heated shower houses, flush toilets, and dump station'; 'Camp store'; 'Registered campers may access a separate beach, boat launch, and 60 docks for exclusive use') + ReserveOhio details ('Distance to Drinking Water'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: From December 8 to April 1 only Loop A and the Bridle Camp stay open. Loop A's heated shower house has bathrooms and an outdoor spigot; full-hookup sites have no water at the site off-peak.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/salt-fork-state-park-campground ('Off-peak: From December 8 to April 1, Loop A of the campground and Bridle Camp remain open...'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727. 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/salt-fork-state-park-campground ('Reservations may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-31

note: Construction (ODNR, 4/24/26): work continues on the Salt Fork Beach Complex, and no facilities in that area are open. The main public beach, not the campers' own. --Claude
summary: Fees $39 + $13 full hookup confirmed; added $35 off-peak. Added 50-amp/W/S, 208 RV sites to 72 ft (all back-in), showers/flush/water/dump/store, year-round with winter loop, deep link, 6-month window, 14-night max. Beach construction noted.
flags: Phone missing: campground (740) 432-1508 (ODNR lists it for the camp store and on the campground page); park office (740) 439-3521, Mon-Fri 8am-4:30pm.

Pin 1.2 km from the RV sites' centroid. The loops string about 2 km along one campground road, A in the north to F/G in the south; the pin is in woods about 150 m from C loop. Centroid 40.08369,-81.49959 (between E and F).

Waterfront 'not waterfront' stands: nearest pads (F loop) sit about 180 m from the lake on imagery; ReserveOhio's coordinates agree with the stored evidence. Campers' own beach and docks are a drive away.
No SPLIT: A, C, E, F, G share one road and check-in station; the equestrian and primitive camps are not RV-general camping.
Website line has the park page; the campground's own page is https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/salt-fork-state-park-campground.
